# Zoo Frontend - React Application

This is a React frontend application for the Zoo Backend CTF challenge platform.

## Project Details
- **Framework**: React with TypeScript
- **Build Tool**: Vite
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **State Management**: React Query (TanStack Query)
- **Design**: Light, minimal, cartoonish UI
- **Backend Integration**: REST API consumption

## Features
- User authentication (login/signup)
- Home page with posts and notices
- Post management (create, view, edit, delete)
- Notice viewing (admin can manage)
- Admin panel with flag access
- Responsive design
